No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, readable receipts, signage, A/B/C graphics, infographic panels, price typography, or actual app screenshots. Unbranded screens and tags remain blank. Fictional illustrative art, not a real merchant photo or testimonial.
Style: Detailed isometric architectural miniature of a real small business, coherent floor layout, believable objects, refined miniature material textures and elevated camera.
Color direction: icy blue, red brick, kraft.
Specific scene: Isometric diorama of a small restaurant's back door: an empty ingredient shelf inside and a delivery loading dock outside with a parked shuttered supplier van. Owner stands in the doorway holding a blank order sheet, considering the gap. Strong physical separation between shop operation and unavailable delivery, cold morning light.
